fasta.description: FASTA files of the genomes (optionally gzipped): comma-separated paths, glob patterns or URLs (one genome per file, named by its file name; exclusive with --fasta_multi)

fasta_multi.description: One FASTA file (optionally gzipped) of one genome per sequence, named by its id (e.g. plasmids): a path or an URL (exclusive with --fasta)

n_core.description: Minimum number of genomes sharing a core gene

blastn_args.description: Options of BLASTN for the alignment of the genes (megablast by default, -task blastn for divergent genes)
